description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific operations related to device upgrades in an embedded Linux environment, specifically for the 'pistachio-marduk' board. It manages image checks, upgrade procedures, and environment configurations.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the provided image for the current platform based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a platform-specific upgrade routine for the device, handling boot partition switching and invoking the NAND upgrade process.
